notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.82.0.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Muc "So nguoi tren 1 m chieu rong loi ra TU HANH LANG" (Bang G.8 / G.2.1.1) chi con ap dung khi phong co cua dan vao hanh lang / buong thang. Neu moi cua deu thoat truc tiep ra ngoai thi muc nay thanh "Khong ap dung" (truoc day o "Tong rong loi ra hanh lang" nhap tu phien truoc lam ket luan KHONG DAT du da them cua). - Ghi chu muc nay noi ro so lieu lay tu nhom 6, khong phu thuoc so cua cua phong; nhom 6 co dong chu giai va KHONG con duoc nho qua phien.
